transcript:
Each skiff had a big carbide lamp that was shining down into the deep.
Emerging from the nostrils were two enormous pads of cotton wool soaked full of blood.
It would have to have been on the few dark nights either side of the new moon.
In the half-dark within, I saw two corpses so close to each other, they were touching.
source: Werner Herzog · Every Man for Himself and God Against All — self-narrated memoir excerpt
